name: Eliza
biography: Eliza is the Vistani spy in Strahd's service at Tser Pool. She is cheery and excitable, and her loyalty to Strahd is fervent. If attacked, she tries to flee; if threatened, she immediately surrenders.

items.name: Cunning Action
items.description: On each of its turns, Eliza can use a bonus action to take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.description: Once per turn, Eliza deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when she hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of Eliza that isn't incapacitated and Eliza doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

items.name: Shortsword
items.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.
